name: The Reverser
gift: Swaps places with any character or guard in sight (two uses a heist, with the 10-second lockout, 11.11). On the rule sheet: an ability, not a parameter. Sounds like a tape played backwards.

name: The Twinned
gift: Acts twice: every hit it lands and every load it takes counts two times. Its crew’s abilities fire once. On the rule sheet (7.3): Damage ×2 and Loot load rate ×2, for itself, always, against its shared 120 health and 80 carry. Sounds like two voices a beat apart.
body: Small, 0.6 m each, 1.8 heads; one character drawn as two silhouettes (21.6)

name: The Unmade
gift: Ignores every law, helpful or harmful. On the rule sheet: no row of 7.3 applies to it. Sounds like paper tearing softly.
